title: DECISION: LogEntryId canonical bytes include operator signature for ID uniqueness
description: entry_id_bytes() in core/canonical.rs includes the operator_signature in the data hashed to produce a LogEntryId, while log_entry_canonical_bytes() (used for signing) excludes it. This means two entries that are identical in content but differ in operator signature produce different IDs. This prevents a collision where the same article signed at different times (e.g. by two operators) would produce the same ID and one would overwrite the other in storage. A future contributor might unify the two functions by always including or always excluding the signature, breaking either ID uniqueness or the signature verification.
